records.claim: The complete Round 38 cohort accounted all eight identities and all sixteen branches. Every protocol, reconstruction, exposure, usage, token-cap, validity, and non-degradation check passed except the primary Span-F1 gain. Treatment raised file coverage by 0.3506579, file precision by 0.375, and valid selections from 6/8 to 8/8.
limitations: All eight live boundaries were terminal candidates, so the accounted-response recovery transition has local test evidence but no live exercise.
This fresh development canary cannot establish confirmation or benchmark clearance.

records.claim: The preregistered primary quality gate failed: slate treatment lost 0.0058338 macro Span-F1 against control. In the Go pair, the slate replaced five precise observations with two 100-line representatives and lost 0.3863544 Span-F1, erasing gains on three other tasks.
limitations: The exposed compact-representative diagnostic remains below the +0.05 canary target relative to Round 38 control.
The representation analysis uses exposed outcomes for hypothesis selection and cannot support H62.
observed_markers: v1 representative policy chooses widest observation per path
